title: 第3章 残躯濒死异力初生第4章 朽气为粮另类修行
slug: 朽道归墟我以残灵证长生
lines: 浓稠如墨的黑雾，彻底吞没了林寂的身形。
后山葬神墓园的风，从来不是风。
是千年不散的战死怨念，是无数修士临死前的滔天不甘，是积压万古的杀伐煞气。阴风卷过荒芜死寂的山谷，发出呜呜咽咽的嘶吼，像是万千亡灵匍匐在地，低声泣诉，又像是凶兽蛰伏蛰伏，随时准备吞噬闯入的活物。
整片天地不见一丝天光，厚重的黑瘴压得人喘不过气。遍地残碑断冢歪斜倒伏，石碑裂痕纵横，布满岁月侵蚀的斑驳痕迹，不少碑身碎裂坍塌，露出底下黑漆漆的坟穴。四周枯树虬曲狰狞，光秃秃的枯枝刺破沉沉黑雾，宛如一只只干枯鬼爪，死死抓向灰暗苍穹。地面碎石混杂着腐朽黑泥，踩上去松软黏腻，每一步落下，都能闻到浓郁到极致的腐臭与血腥混杂的诡异气息。
前山青云和煦，灵风温润，是人人向往的修仙净土。
这里，是埋葬一切生机的地狱。
两名执事离去的脚步声早已消失在山路尽头，最后一点人声彻底断绝。偌大墓园死寂一片，唯有阴风穿谷、黑雾翻涌，将林寂孤身困在这片绝境之中。
他刚站稳身形，一股狂暴霸道的腐朽道气，便骤然从四面八方穿刺而来！
不同于寻常灵气的温和、煞气的凌厉，墓园独有的腐朽道气，阴冷、黏腻、霸道，带着吞噬一切生机的诡异特性，无孔不入地钻进他的七窍、毛孔、经脉血肉之中。
轰！
一瞬间，剧烈到极致的剧痛，猛地炸开在四肢百骸！
仿佛有无数细小的虫豸，在疯狂啃噬他的血肉、撕裂他的经脉、钻磨他的骨骼。痛感并非转瞬即逝的刺痛，而是连绵不断、层层叠加的腐蚀之痛，顺着血脉蔓延全身，死死缠裹住他的每一寸身躯。
林寂浑身猛地一颤，单薄的身躯瞬间绷紧，牙关死死咬紧，喉间溢出一声压抑的闷哼。
他本就是被判定为朽体废根的体质，无法吸纳天地正统灵气，身躯远比寻常修士孱弱。此前在前山，仅有微弱朽气蛰伏体内，尚且能维持肉身安稳，可此刻直面墓园千年积淀的腐朽道气，他的肉身根本没有半分抵御之力。
黑色的腐朽气流顺着毛孔疯狂侵入，飞速冲刷着他脆弱的经脉。
经脉撕裂、血肉腐蚀、骨骼发麻，三重剧痛交织碾压，层层叠叠席卷而来。短短数息，林寂的皮肤便浮现出密密麻麻的灰黑纹路，如同狰狞的蛛网，顺着脖颈、手腕、四肢飞速蔓延，那是生机被侵蚀、肉身濒临崩坏的征兆。
他踉跄着后退两步，脚下一软，重重跪倒在冰冷泥泞的黑泥地里。
双膝砸在碎石之上，刺骨的冰凉混着剧痛传来，可相比于体内翻涌的腐蚀之痛，早已微不足道。洗得发白的粗布衣袍沾满黑泥与血污，原本被执事捏伤的双肩伤口，在腐朽道气的侵蚀下彻底撕裂，暗红血水浸透布料，又被诡异的黑气快速染黑、凝固。
视线开始模糊。
眼前的黑雾越来越浓、越来越暗沉，耳边的阴风嘶吼渐渐变得遥远，浑身的力气正在飞速流失，四肢百骸僵硬麻木，连抬手的力气都尽数消散。
他能清晰感觉到，自己的生机正在被这片墓园无情剥夺、碾碎、吞噬。
“果然……朽体根本扛不住墓园煞气……”
林寂心底掠过一丝冰冷的认知。
此前他察觉朽气与墓园凶煞同源，以为这是自己的逆天机缘，却终究低估了千年葬地的恐怖。他体内的朽气太过微弱，仅仅只是本源雏形，根本无法抗衡整片墓园积压千年的腐朽道力。
外力肆虐，肉身崩损，生机溃散。
死亡，正在飞速逼近。
他的体温飞速变冷，指尖、脚尖彻底麻木，呼吸变得微弱急促，胸口剧烈起伏，每一次吸气，都像是吞入了滚烫的铁砂，灼烧着五脏六腑。体表的灰黑纹路愈发浓郁，几乎要彻底覆盖全身，肉身已然走到崩毁的边缘。
按照这个速度，不出片刻，他就会被腐朽道气彻底侵蚀，血肉消融、神魂寂灭，化作这片墓园的一抔黑泥，无声无息消散，连尸骨都留不下半点痕迹。
content_en:
The thick black mist completely engulfed Lin Ji's figure.
The wind in the God Burial Cemetery in the back hill is never the wind.
It is the resentment of death in battle that has lasted for thousands of years, the overwhelming unwillingness of countless monks before their death, and the evil spirit of killing that has been accumulated for eternity. The dark wind swept through the desolate and silent valley, making a whimpering roar, like thousands of undead crawling on the ground, whimpering in a low voice, or like a ferocious beast dormant, ready to devour the living creatures that intruded at any time.
There was no trace of skylight in the entire world, and the thick black miasma made people breathless. The ruined monuments and tombs are lying crookedly all over the place. The stone monuments are cracked and covered with mottled traces of years of erosion. Many of the monuments have broken and collapsed, exposing the dark graves underneath. The dead trees all around were twisted and ferocious, and the bare dead branches pierced the dark fog, like withered ghost claws, clawing at the gray sky. The gravel on the ground is mixed with decayed black mud, which feels soft and sticky when you step on it. With every step you take, you can smell the strange smell of rotten odor mixed with blood.
The green clouds on the front mountain are warm and the spiritual wind is gentle. It is the pure land that everyone longs for to cultivate immortality.
Here is a hell where all life is buried.
The leaving footsteps of the two deacons had long since disappeared at the end of the mountain road, and the last human voice was completely cut off. The huge cemetery was completely silent, with only the dark wind blowing through the valley and the billowing black mist trapping Lin Jing alone in this desperate situation.
As soon as he stood firm, a violent and domineering wave of rotten Tao Qi suddenly penetrated from all directions!
Different from the gentleness of ordinary auras and the fierceness of evil spirits, the unique rotten Tao Qi of the cemetery is cold, sticky, and domineering, with the strange characteristics of devouring all vitality, and penetrates pervasively into his seven orifices, pores, meridians, flesh and blood.
boom!
In an instant, an extremely severe pain suddenly exploded all over his limbs!
It was as if countless tiny insects were frantically gnawing at his flesh, tearing his meridians, and grinding away at his bones. The pain was not a fleeting sting, but a continuous, layer-by-layer corrosive pain that spread throughout his body along his blood vessels and tightly wrapped around every inch of his body.
"Uh-"
Lin Ji's whole body trembled suddenly, her thin body instantly tensed up, her teeth clenched tightly, and a suppressed groan escaped from her throat.
His constitution was judged to be rotten and useless. He was unable to absorb the orthodox spiritual energy of heaven and earth, and his body was far weaker than that of ordinary monks. Before in Qianshan, there was only a weak decaying energy dormant in his body, which was able to keep his body stable. But now, facing the decaying energy accumulated in the cemetery for thousands of years, his body had no resistance at all.
The black decaying air flow crazily invaded along the pores, rapidly washing away his fragile meridians.
The meridians are torn, the flesh and blood are corroded, the bones are numb, and the three kinds of severe pain are intertwined and crushing, sweeping over each other layer by layer. In just a few breaths, dense gray and black lines appeared on Lin Ji's skin, like ferocious spider webs, spreading rapidly along his neck, wrists, and limbs. This was a sign that his vitality was eroded and his body was on the verge of collapse.
He staggered back two steps, his feet went weak, and he fell heavily to his knees in the cold, muddy black mud.
His knees hit the gravel, and a biting coldness mixed with severe pain came, but it was already insignificant compared to the corrosive pain surging in his body. The washed-white coarse cloth robe was stained with black mud and blood. The wounds on both shoulders that had been pinched by the deacon were completely torn apart by the erosion of the decaying Tao Qi. The dark red blood soaked into the fabric, and was quickly dyed black and solidified by the strange black Qi.
Vision begins to blur.
The black fog in front of him became thicker and darker, and the roar of the wind in his ears gradually became distant. The strength in his body was rapidly losing, his limbs were stiff and numb, and even the strength to raise his hands was gone.
He could clearly feel that his vitality was being ruthlessly deprived, crushed, and devoured by this cemetery.
"Sure enough... a rotten body cannot withstand the evil spirit of the cemetery..."
A cold realization passed through Lin Ji's heart.
Previously, he discovered that the rotten energy and the evil in the cemetery had the same origin, and thought that this was his fate. However, he underestimated the horror of the thousand-year-old burial ground. The rotten energy in his body was too weak, just the prototype of its origin, and could not compete with the decadent power accumulated in the entire cemetery for thousands of years.
External forces raged, the body collapsed, and the vitality collapsed.
Death is approaching rapidly.
His body temperature quickly turned cold, his fingertips and toes were completely numb, his breathing became weak and rapid, and his chest heaved violently. Every time he took a breath, it was like swallowing hot iron sand, burning his internal organs. The gray and black lines on the body surface became more and more dense, almost completely covering the whole body, and the physical body was on the verge of collapse.
At this speed, in less than a moment, he will be completely eroded by the decaying Tao Qi, his flesh and blood will melt away, his soul will be extinguished, and he will turn into a handful of black mud in this cemetery, disappearing silently, leaving no trace of his corpse.
title_en: Chapter 3: The broken body is on the verge of death and new powers emerge Chapter 4: The decayed energy is used as food for alternative practice
